always-trash-changes-what-rm-means.description: rm.always_trash makes every rm a trash move, including the ones in scripts — `-p` on any path the user did not type
always-trash-changes-what-rm-means.read_when: writing a script that deletes files, or wondering where a deleted probe went

capsule-is-one-directory-one-container.description: capsule is one directory, one container, one CLI — content-hash rebuild detection, creds by read-only directory mount, never an image layer
capsule-is-one-directory-one-container.read_when: touching capsule, the Dockerfile, or container credentials

claude-hooks-write-pane-state-not-versio.description: the tmux digit wears Claude's state from hooks writing a pane option — pane, not window, because the option must die with its pane
claude-hooks-write-pane-state-not-versio.read_when: touching the status bar's Claude state, or the tmux-claude-state hook

every-abort-measurement-was-missing-wget.description: every measurement of the offline first-save abort ran on a PATH with no wget, which the machine has — the bug is unmeasured on a faithful PATH
every-abort-measurement-was-missing-wget.read_when: measuring an offline behaviour, or trusting the mason abort numbers

install-sh-is-four-things-in-one-order.description: install.sh is one order that is load-bearing — brew bootstrap, trust the tinty tap, bundle, MasonUpdate, chezmoi apply last
install-sh-is-four-things-in-one-order.read_when: touching provisioning, or a fresh machine that came up half-configured

llm-launches-any-agent.description: `llm -a <program>` starts any agent on the proxy — the program is never registered, only its default args and env are
llm-launches-any-agent.read_when: launching an agent through the proxy, or adding one to agents.json

mason-never-refreshes-at-launch.description: nvim's mason never refreshes its registry at launch — the offline fetch can discard a save, and the bootstrap moves to install.sh
mason-never-refreshes-at-launch.read_when: touching lsp.lua, mason, or the fresh-machine editor path

mason-refresh-off-trades-auto-bootstrap.description: mason's registry refresh is off — launching Neovim offline discarded the first save; the fresh-machine bootstrap moves to install.sh
mason-refresh-off-trades-auto-bootstrap.read_when: touching nvim's lsp.lua, mason, or the fresh-machine install path

nushell-binds-names-at-parse-time.description: nushell binds names at parse time and three kinds of name differently — def is order-free, alias and source are not
nushell-binds-names-at-parse-time.read_when: reordering a source or alias in config.nu, or chasing a silently dead navigation

nvims-built-ins-over-plugins.description: where nvim prefers built-ins over plugins — shift-select over a plugin, native LSP maps over which-key ones, vim.hl over the deprecated highlight
nvims-built-ins-over-plugins.read_when: adding a plugin to the editor, or asking why a map is not in keymaps.lua

osc7-is-where-tmux-learns-the-cwd.description: OSC 7 is the only way tmux learns where a nushell pane is — #{pane_current_path} is the process cwd, which nushell's cd never moves
osc7-is-where-tmux-learns-the-cwd.read_when: touching tmux's @cwd, nushell's osc7 setting, or chasing a split landing in the wrong directory

panes-are-found-not-addressed.description: tmux panes are reached by fuzzy-finding their name and content (cockpit `s s`, search sessions), not by a window address — recency order, swap-pane to pull, a detached session as a shelf
panes-are-found-not-addressed.read_when: touching the cockpit's search sessions row, pane navigation, window indices, or the tmux-panes channel

the-editor-claude-is-a-tmux-pane.description: nvim's Claude pane is a real tmux pane through claude-tmux, spawned via cll so the model is picked at spawn and the login survives
the-editor-claude-is-a-tmux-pane.read_when: touching claude.lua, the nvim↔claude wiring, or a login profile that is not picked up

the-help-command-is-two-searches-over-on.description: help reads entries from the .nuon surfaces, ? reads prose line by line through television — one corpus, four constraints
the-help-command-is-two-searches-over-on.read_when: touching help.nu, the manual, or the .nuon surfaces

the-launchd-agents-and-where-claude-read.description: the proxy is two launchd agents and the MCP server is registered in ~/.claude.json, not settings.json
the-launchd-agents-and-where-claude-read.read_when: wiring the proxy's service, or debugging a missing MCP server

the-pwd-hook-fails-in-order.description: a PWD-hook closure error aborts its own tail and every later closure — the dirstack append must stay first
the-pwd-hook-fails-in-order.read_when: appending a PWD closure, or chasing a dead dirstack

tinty-owns-the-palette-every-reader-foll.description: tinty owns the palette and every reader follows one tinty apply — tmux via ANSI slots, nvim by rebuilding lualine on ColorScheme, WezTerm over OSC
tinty-owns-the-palette-every-reader-foll.read_when: changing the palette, touching a hex value, or asking why the statusline disagrees with the cursor

tmux-copy-pipe-is-one-binding-two-arms.description: the tmux copy sink is an option every copy path must name — a sink chosen and never used is the bug that shipped for weeks
tmux-copy-pipe-is-one-binding-two-arms.read_when: touching tmux copy bindings, set-clipboard, or chasing a selection that does not paste

tv-needs-a-tty-and-the-unhijack-rides-ev.description: television needs a real TTY and its four action-bound channels are un-hijacked on every call; the guards and flags are all measured
tv-needs-a-tty-and-the-unhijack-rides-ev.read_when: writing a tv channel, a picker, or an interactive-only entry point

wezterm-keeps-only-local-chrome.description: WezTerm keeps only local chrome — and disable_default_key_bindings is load-bearing, because stock bindings ship a second set of pane keys
wezterm-keeps-only-local-chrome.read_when: editing wezterm.lua, or asking why a tmux key does nothing

xdg-constants-are-launch-time.description: $nu.default-config-dir and $nu.history-path are launch-time constants — assigning XDG_CONFIG_HOME in env.nu runs too late to move them
xdg-constants-are-launch-time.read_when: touching XDG_CONFIG_HOME, the history path, or a config landing in ~/Library
